item.tib: yi dam yag sha me dbal bcud dril rgyun gyi rnal 'byor ye shes dwangs ma
item.coloph: ces pa'i tshul 'di ni bla chen dran pa dgyes pa'i 'bangs/ rig 'dzin kun grol gsang ba rtsal gyis rtse drug lhun po sgang gi seng ge g.yu ral rtse nas spyan drangs te/ slar gnas dus phun sum tshogs pa'i skabs su gtan la dbab ste yi ge dang po'i byed po tshe dbang g.yung drung bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis bgyis pas dge legs su gyur cig/
